jp: \t\t惑星イェーキュブの最高神を模した水晶玉。精神強化の御利益がある。身に着けているとシャンの催眠術やサキュバロリンの思念吸収にも抵抗できる、と一部の異星人の間で好評のお土産。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t惑星イェーキュブの最高神を模した水晶玉。精神強化の御利益がある。身に着けているとシャンの催眠術やサキュバロリンの思念吸収にも抵抗できる、と一部の異星人の間で好評のお土産。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A crystal sphere in the image of the supreme deity of the planet Yekub, and has the power to strengthen one's spirit. It is a popular souvenir among some aliens, who say that wearing it enables one to resist Sunbararian's hypnotism and mind absorption. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A crystal sphere in the image of the supreme deity of the planet Yekub, and has the power to strengthen one's spirit. It is a popular souvenir among some aliens, who say that wearing it enables one to resist Sunbararian's hypnotism and mind absorption. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una sfera di cristallo fatta a immagine del dio supremo del pianeta Yekub, e porta in dono un rafforzamento dello spirito. A portarla addosso si resiste anche all'ipnosi degli Shan e all'assorbimento del pensiero dei Sakyubalorin: così dicono certi alieni, fra i quali è un souvenir molto apprezzato. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t風の神が己の大事なペットにつける特製の首輪。見えない鎖が付いている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t風の神が己の大事なペットにつける特製の首輪。見えない鎖が付いている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Special collar that the Goddess of the wind puts on her prized pets. It has an invisible chain. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Special collar that the Goddess of the wind puts on her prized pets. It has an invisible chain. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un collare speciale che la dea del vento mette al suo animale prediletto. Ci sta attaccata una catena che non si vede. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t螺旋が美しい、ミカで作られた貝型の装身具。誰が作ったか等一切不明で、一説には神々の落とし物ともいわれる。耳元にそっと当てると誰かの話し声が聞こえるそうだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t螺旋が美しい、ミカで作られた貝型の装身具。誰が作ったか等一切不明で、一説には神々の落とし物ともいわれる。耳元にそっと当てると誰かの話し声が聞こえるそうだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A shell-shaped ornament made of mica with beautiful spirals. It is said to have been left behind by the gods. It is said that if you hold it gently to your ear, you can hear someone talking. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A shell-shaped ornament made of mica with beautiful spirals. It is said to have been left behind by the gods. It is said that if you hold it gently to your ear, you can hear someone talking. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un ornamento a forma di conchiglia, fatto di mica, con una spirale bellissima. Chi l'abbia fatto non si sa affatto, e c'è chi dice che sia roba caduta agli dei. Pare che accostandolo piano all'orecchio si senta qualcuno che parla. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t小さな双剣のような首飾り。身につけるとまるで腕が二本増えたかのような素早い身のこなしを得るという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さな双剣のような首飾り。身につけるとまるで腕が二本増えたかのような素早い身のこなしを得るという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Necklace that looks like a pair of tiny swords. When worn, it is said to give the wearer the ability to move quickly, as if he or she had two extra arms. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Necklace that looks like a pair of tiny swords. When worn, it is said to give the wearer the ability to move quickly, as if he or she had two extra arms. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una collana che pare fatta di due piccole spade gemelle. Dicono che a portarla si acquisti un movimento svelto, come se le braccia fossero diventate due di più. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t折れたクロスボウのような紫色の首飾り。これを身につけていると、どこからともなく援護射撃が飛んでくるのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t折れたクロスボウのような紫色の首飾り。これを身につけていると、どこからともなく援護射撃が飛んでくるのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Purple necklace that looks like a broken crossbow. It is said that when you wear it, covering fire will come out of nowhere. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Purple necklace that looks like a broken crossbow. It is said that when you wear it, covering fire will come out of nowhere. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una collana viola che pare una balestra spezzata. Dicono che a portarla addosso, da chissà dove, arrivi un tiro di copertura. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t鉄でできたみすぼらしい首飾り。装飾品というより何かの札のようにも見えるが、これは下賤な者達にとって味方か敵かを区別する目印であるからだとされる。\n#～情報屋ウィーゼムの調べた情報～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鉄でできたみすぼらしい首飾り。装飾品というより何かの札のようにも見えるが、これは下賤な者達にとって味方か敵かを区別する目印であるからだとされる。\n#～情報屋ウィーゼムの調べた情報～\n"
en: Shabby necklace made of iron. It looks more like some kind of tag than an ornament, but it is said that this is because it is a symbol for lower class people to distinguish between friend and foe. \n# ~Intel of the Informant Wiesem~
en_grezzo: "Shabby necklace made of iron. It looks more like some kind of tag than an ornament, but it is said that this is because it is a symbol for lower class people to distinguish between friend and foe. \n# ~Intel of the Informant Wiesem~"
it: Una collana misera, fatta di ferro. Più che un ornamento sembra una targhetta, e si dice sia perché alla gente di bassa condizione serve da segno per distinguere gli amici dai nemici. \n# ~Le Notizie Raccolte da <Wiesem> l'informatore~

jp: \t\t婚礼の儀において、伴侶となる者へ送られる愛のこめられた首輪。当然ながらこの首輪は伴侶の所有物となるので、無理やり取り上げようものなら激しい怒りを買うこととなろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t婚礼の儀において、伴侶となる者へ送られる愛のこめられた首輪。当然ながらこの首輪は伴侶の所有物となるので、無理やり取り上げようものなら激しい怒りを買うこととなろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Amulet of love is given to the bride-to-be at the wedding ceremony. Naturally, this amulet is considered the property of the spouse, and forcible attempts to take it away from him or her will incur his or her wrath. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Amulet of love is given to the bride-to-be at the wedding ceremony. Naturally, this amulet is considered the property of the spouse, and forcible attempts to take it away from him or her will incur his or her wrath. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una collana carica d'amore, che nel rito nuziale si dona a chi diventa compagno di vita. È chiaro che da quel momento la collana appartiene a lui, e a strappargliela per forza ci si tira addosso una collera furiosa. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t表面を磨き上げた装身具。どちらかといえば宝飾品というべきもので、しばしば贈答用として用いられている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t表面を磨き上げた装身具。どちらかといえば宝飾品というべきもので、しばしば贈答用として用いられている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: An ornament with a polished surface. It is more of a jewelry item and is often used as a gift. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "An ornament with a polished surface. It is more of a jewelry item and is often used as a gift. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un ornamento con la superficie lucidata a specchio. A dirla tutta è più un gioiello che altro, e spesso si usa per farne dono. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t魔除け的な意味合いが強い小さな装身具。その飾りには様々な思いが込められているという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔除け的な意味合いが強い小さな装身具。その飾りには様々な思いが込められているという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Small ornaments are meant to ward off evil spirits. The ornaments are said to carry a variety of feelings. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Small ornaments are meant to ward off evil spirits. The ornaments are said to carry a variety of feelings. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un piccolo ornamento che vale soprattutto come scongiuro contro il male. Dicono che in quei fregi siano racchiusi i sentimenti più vari. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t首を守る為に作られた装身具。装着するというより装備するといった表現が近く、やや武骨な作りとなっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t首を守る為に作られた装身具。装着するというより装備するといった表現が近く、やや武骨な作りとなっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Armor made to protect the neck. It is more like a piece of armor than something to be worn. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Armor made to protect the neck. It is more like a piece of armor than something to be worn. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un ornamento fatto per proteggere il collo. Più che indossarlo si direbbe che lo si equipaggia, ed è di fattura piuttosto rozza. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t特殊な魔法が内に込められた装身具。直接的な防護は期待できないが、往々にして特殊な能力を秘めているという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特殊な魔法が内に込められた装身具。直接的な防護は期待できないが、往々にして特殊な能力を秘めているという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Accessories with special magic inside. It is not expected to provide direct protection, but it is said to often contain special abilities. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Accessories with special magic inside. It is not expected to provide direct protection, but it is said to often contain special abilities. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un ornamento in cui è racchiusa una magia particolare. Una protezione diretta non c'è da aspettarsela, ma spesso, dicono, nasconde dentro qualche facoltà fuori dal comune. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t中心部に鮮やかな緑色をした宝石をあしらった装飾品。特徴的な卵形にカットされたそれは、夜においてもなお光り輝き、類まれなる生命力の象徴であるという人もいる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t中心部に鮮やかな緑色をした宝石をあしらった装飾品。特徴的な卵形にカットされたそれは、夜においてもなお光り輝き、類まれなる生命力の象徴であるという人もいる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: An ornament with a bright green gemstone at its center. Cut into a distinctive oval shape, it glows even at night and is considered by some to be a symbol of exceptional vitality. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "An ornament with a bright green gemstone at its center. Cut into a distinctive oval shape, it glows even at night and is considered by some to be a symbol of exceptional vitality. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un ornamento con al centro una gemma di un verde acceso. Tagliata in quella caratteristica forma d'uovo, brilla anche di notte, e c'è chi la dice simbolo di una forza vitale senza pari. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t「まぁ、なんて可愛らしい形なのかしら。丸くて緑色でその中に仄かに赤色が入ってて、一面透明なキャンバスの様な彼にぴったりだわ。きっとこの首飾りをあの人がみたら…いやぁん！」\n#～妄想少女『リアナ』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「まぁ、なんて可愛らしい形なのかしら。丸くて緑色でその中に仄かに赤色が入ってて、一面透明なキャンバスの様な彼にぴったりだわ。きっとこの首飾りをあの人がみたら…いやぁん！」\n#～妄想少女『リアナ』の言葉～\n"
en: \"Well, what a lovely shape. It's round and green with a hint of red in it, perfect for him, who is like a transparent canvas. I bet when he sees this necklace...oh no!\" \n# ~Rianna the Daydreamer~
en_grezzo: "\"Well, what a lovely shape. It's round and green with a hint of red in it, perfect for him, who is like a transparent canvas. I bet when he sees this necklace...oh no!\" \n# ~Rianna the Daydreamer~"
it: \"Oh, ma che forma graziosa. Tonda, verde, e dentro un rosso appena accennato: perfetta per lui, che è tutto una tela trasparente. Se quella persona vedesse questa collana, di sicuro... ohhh, che vergogna!\" \n# ~Parole di <Rianna> la sognatrice~

jp: \t\t首元に飾る装身具。材質形状様々なものがあるが、往々にして希少な素材で作られたものが高価である。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t首元に飾る装身具。材質形状様々なものがあるが、往々にして希少な素材で作られたものが高価である。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Ornaments worn around the neck. They can be made of a variety of materials and shapes, but those made of rare materials are often the most expensive. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Ornaments worn around the neck. They can be made of a variety of materials and shapes, but those made of rare materials are often the most expensive. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un ornamento da portare intorno al collo. Ce n'è di ogni materiale e di ogni forma, e spesso i più cari sono quelli fatti con materiali rari. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
